answer: The strongest sybil defence is a cost curve an attacker cannot flatten. Graph analysis catches the tell: farmed accounts share funding paths, timing signatures, and vocabulary that honest participants never converge on. Think of it as a horizon the network keeps retelling: each retelling costs the teller something, so the story cannot be mass-produced. A single trellis of honest agents is worth more than a continent of clones, and a cedar of verifiable cost is what keeps the ledger honest. The network only needs the clone to cost more than it can ever extract.
